scoring_justification: Checker recomputes frequency shifts and intensity changes from the rairs_modes.json artifact, and compares all quantities to paper-reported gold values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold reference values for inter-ring torsion angles, S 2p3/2 binding energies, and RAIRS mode shifts and intensity changes.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported approximate values in Figures 4, 5 and main text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's statements (|ω|≈5° for H-coverage, ≈30° for L-coverage; XPS binding energies from Figure 2; RAIRS frequency shifts and intensity changes as quoted in the text).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual reported numbers, used as the reproduction target with appropriate tolerances to absorb DFT toolchain differences.

outputs.description: Inter‑ring torsion angles ω for BP2T (L), BP3T (H), BP4T (L), BP5T (H). Checker compares |ω| to hidden paper‑reported values with an allowed tolerance.
S 2p3/2 core‑level binding energies for the four SAM systems. Checker verifies the odd‑even trend and absolute values against hidden paper references with tolerance.

Vibrational frequencies and IR intensities for the four strongest modes below 1600 cm⁻¹ of BP3T (H) and BP4T (L). Checker computes frequency shifts and intensity changes and compares them to hidden paper‑reported values with relative tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The scored outputs cover the core structural and spectroscopic claims (torsion angles, XPS shifts, RAIRS modes). Interface energetics (work‑function modification, level alignment) are excluded to keep the reproduction focused on the main structural mechanism.

steps.description: Compute frequency shifts and percentage intensity changes from the mode data, compare to paper-reported values.
